Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call today — appreciate the clarity on your latency SLAs and the three workloads you described (patient messaging, chart summarization, and search embeddings). Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock in the right technical stakeholders: 

Call notes (short):
- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency for chart summarization while keeping <1% regression in quality.
- Security: ClearView will require SOC 2 evidence + data residency options for test data.
- Volume: expect 30–60 reqs/sec in peak windows; batch-friendly but need 95th p99 < 250ms.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical showcase (hands-on architecture + performance Q&A). Suggested time slots (your TZ):
- Wed Sep 23 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Thu Sep 24 — 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Fri Sep 25 — 9:00–10:15 AM PT

Could you confirm which slot works best and who from ClearView will attend (engineering, security, product)? That will help us bring the right Redwood lineup — Marcus (solutions eng) + Ben (solutions/sales) + me.

I've attached a draft agenda (technical-showcase-agenda.xlsx) and a very early SOW stub for context (ClearView_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf). If you prefer Google Meet instead of Zoom due to org policy, say the word and we'll send that.

Next steps on our side once you confirm:
1) Lock calendar and send invite with video link.
2) Share a short pre-call checklist (env vars, sample payloads) so Marcus can tailor the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Priyom Das
